environmental_entry_points: tools/generate_environment_audio.py delegates crickets to the same preparation
tools/generate_environment_details.py delegates day_insects and chirp to the same preparation
processing: Light zero-phase band limiting, joint channel gain to the RMS target with peak cap. Loops use a 1.5-second equal-power tail-to-head crossfade and retain stereo; chirps use edge fades and mono. The existing environment writer applies DC correction and its final phrase fades. No voice synthesis, pitch shifting, time stretching, artificial stereo widening or added reverb.
